blocks.text: Phenylamine do qism ke reactions deti hai:

blocks.alt: Phenylamine: Kekule benzene ring aik N atom se juri jis par lone pair aur do H atoms hain. 'sp2 hybridized' wali lakeer se teer ring ke carbons ki taraf; 'sp2 hybridized' se teer N ki taraf.
blocks.caption: Phenylamine mein hybridisation: sp2 ring carbons aur nitrogen atom (kitab ke PDF safha 124 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab is drawing mein nitrogen ko sp³ hybridized kehti hai. Lekin Figure 24.1 (topic 24.3.1) mein kitab khud kehti hai ke nitrogen planar (hamwar) hai aur us ka lone pair p orbital mein hai jo ring ke π electrons se overlap karta hai; yeh sp² hai, is liye drawing mein sp² likha hai. Ring ke chhe carbons bhi sp² hain. Asal phenylamine mein nitrogen thora sa pyramid jaisa hai (sp² aur sp³ ke darmiyan).
a) Bromine water ke saath reaction

Amino group (–NH₂) ortho-para directing group hai, yaani aane wala electrophile ortho (“o”) aur para (“p”) positions par hamla karta hai. Amino group benzene ring ko kaafi reactive bana deta hai, khaas taur par in positions par. Is liye phenylamine ki bromination benzene se tez hoti hai, aur dono ortho aur para positions aik hi reaction mein Br se bhar jati hain. 2,4,6-tribromophenylamine ka safaid (white) precipitate banta hai.

blocks.alt: Phenylamine (NH2 wali ring) + 3Br2 se 2,4,6-tribromophenylamine (safaid precipitate), jis ki ring mein oopar NH2 aur dono ortho aur para positions par Br hain, + 3HBr.
blocks.caption: Phenylamine ki bromination se 2,4,6-tribromophenylamine (kitab ke PDF safha 125 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: b) Nitrous acid ke saath reaction aur azo compounds ka banna

Phenylamine primary amine hai, is liye nitrous acid se react kar ke phenyldiazonium salt banati hai. Is reaction ko diazotization kehte hain. Jin organic compounds mein diazonium ion, –N⁺≡N (diazo group), functional group ho, unhein diazo compounds kehte hain. Aliphatic aur aromatic dono primary amines nitrous acid se diazonium salts deti hain. Nitrous acid unstable hai, is liye ise in situ (wahin usi waqt) sodium nitrite aur HCl se banaya jata hai. Mixture ko barf se 10 °C se neeche rakha jata hai, kyunke diazonium salts unstable hain aur room temperature par bhi toot kar nitrogen gas, N₂, chhor dete hain.

blocks.alt: Teen satrein: NaNO2 + HCl se HNO2 + NaCl; phenylamine + HNO2 + HCl, 10 darje C se kam, se phenyldiazonium chloride (ring-N(+) triple bond N Cl-) + 2H2O; phenyldiazonium chloride + H2O, garmi (Heat), se phenol + N2 + HCl.
blocks.caption: Phenylamine ki diazotisation aur phenyldiazonium chloride se phenol (kitab ke PDF safha 125 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pehli line: HNO₂, NaNO₂ aur HCl se usi waqt banta hai. Doosri line: phenylamine 10 °C se neeche phenyldiazonium chloride banati hai. Teesri line: diazonium salt ko paani ke saath garam (Heat) karne par phenol, N₂ aur HCl bante hain. Kitab ne ‘HCl’ ko ‘Hcl’ chhapa hai.

Alkyl diazonium salts har halat mein bohat unstable hain, is liye inhein alag (isolate) nahi kiya ja sakta. Aryl diazonium salts kam temperature par kaafi stable hain. Aromatic diazo compounds ka yeh izafi stability positive charge ke aromatic ring par phail (delocalise ho) jane se aati hai. Benzene diazonium salts bohat se organic compounds banane mein ahem intermediates (darmiyani maadde) hain.

blocks.alt: Kekule benzene ring N(+) triple bond N se juri, + charge ring se jure nitrogen par.
blocks.caption: Benzene diazonium ion ki banawat (kitab ke PDF safha 125 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Diazonium compounds ke coupling reactions

Aryl diazonium salts ke bohat activated aromatic compounds, jaise phenols aur amines, ke saath reactions ko coupling reactions kehte hain. In ke products mein –N=N– bond hota hai aur inhein azo compounds kehte hain. Coupling reaction mein positive charge wala diazonium ion electrophile ka kaam karta hai aur phenol ki benzene ring mein para position par lag jata hai.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhein
blocks.text: Phenol ke saath coupling halke alkaline solution mein hoti hai, aur aromatic amines ke saath halke acidic halaat mein.

blocks.alt: Do satron mein: benzenediazonium chloride (ring-N(+) triple bond N Cl-) + phenol (ring-OH), teer ke oopar NaOH, se p-hydroxyazobenzene (narangi thos), ring-N=N-ring-OH.
blocks.caption: Benzenediazonium chloride ki phenol se coupling (kitab ke PDF safha 126 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Mechanism

blocks.alt: Mechanism: Ph-N=N(+) + phenol (Kekule ring), O ke lone pair aur ring ke pi bonds se aakhri N tak curly arrows; darmiyani maadda Ph-N=N-C(H) ring jis mein C=O(+)H, C-H bond se ring mein aur C=O se O par curly arrows; phir H+ nikalne se p-hydroxyazobenzene (azo compound).
blocks.caption: Diazonium ion aur phenol ki coupling ka mechanism (kitab ke PDF safha 126 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Qadam ba qadam: (1) diazonium ion ka aakhri nitrogen positive hai, yeh electrophile hai. (2) Phenol ke oxygen ka lone pair ring mein dhakela jata hai aur ring ke π electrons OH ke saamne wale (para) carbon se nitrogen par hamla karte hain. (3) Intermediate mein para carbon par N aur H dono hain aur oxygen par positive charge hai. (4) Yeh carbon H⁺ chhorta hai, ring dobara aromatic ho jati hai aur p-hydroxyazobenzene banta hai. Kitab ne aakhri teer par ‘–H’ likha hai; asal mein proton (H⁺) nikalta hai, is liye drawing mein –H⁺ hai.
Dyes ka banna

Coupling reaction se mukhtalif qism ke azo dyes banaye ja sakte hain. p-Dimethylaminoazobenzene ko Butter yellow kehte hain; yeh pehle khurak mein use hota tha, lekin carcinogenic (cancer paida karne wala) hone ki wajah se ab khurak mein is ka istemal mana hai.

blocks.alt: Do satron mein: benzenediazonium chloride (Kekule ring) + N,N-dimethylphenylamine (ring-N(CH3)2), teer ke oopar CH3COOH, se p-dimethylaminoazo benzene (butter yellow), ring-N=N-ring-N(CH3)2, + HCl.
blocks.caption: Butter yellow ka banna (kitab ke PDF safha 126 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Methyl orange acid-base indicator hai aur diazotized sulfanilic acid aur N,N-dimethylphenylamine se is tarah banta hai:

blocks.alt: Do satron mein: NaO3S-ring-N(+) triple bond N Cl- (diazotised sulphanilic acid) + N,N-dimethylphenylamine, teer ke oopar CH3COOH, se methyl orange, NaO3S-ring-N=N-ring-N(CH3)2, + HCl.
blocks.caption: Methyl orange ka banna (kitab ke PDF safha 126 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ne methyl orange ke product mein do nitrogen ke darmiyan teen lakeerein (N≡N) chhapi hain aur naam ‘p-dimethylaminoazo benzene’ likha hai. Dono ghalat hain: azo dye mein N=N (double bond) hota hai, aur ‘p-dimethylaminoazobenzene’ butter yellow ka naam hai. Methyl orange mein is ke ilawa –SO₃Na group bhi hai. Is liye drawing mein N=N aur naam ‘methyl orange’ hai.

Azo dyes mein azo group (Ph–N=N–Ph) ko chromophore (rang dene wala group) kehte hain. Yahi group dyes ke gehre rang ka zimmedar hai, jo peele aur narangi se le kar laal, neele aur hare tak hote hain, is par depend karte hue ke benzene rings par aur kaun se groups lage hain. Khurak ke bohat se rangon mein azo dyes hote hain.
Quick Check 24.4

blocks.prompt: Azo dyes rangeen compounds hain jo phenylamine ke diazonium salt aur kisi activated benzene ring wale aryl compound ke reaction se bante hain. (i) Phenylamine aur 2-methylphenol se dye kaise banayenge? (ii) Reaction ke halaat ke saath qadam ba qadam equations likhein.
blocks.explanation: Qadam 1 (diazotization): phenylamine ko halke HCl mein ghol kar 10 °C se neeche NaNO₂ ka solution milayein: C₆H₅NH₂ + NaNO₂ + 2HCl → C₆H₅N₂⁺Cl⁻ + NaCl + 2H₂O. Qadam 2 (coupling): thanda diazonium solution NaOH(aq) mein ghule 2-methylphenol mein milayein: C₆H₅N₂⁺Cl⁻ + HOC₆H₄CH₃ → C₆H₅–N=N–C₆H₃(CH₃)OH + HCl. Azo group OH ke para position par lagta hai aur rangeen azo dye banta hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Phenylamine + HNO₂ (10 °C se neeche): benzenediazonium chloride; paani ke saath garam karne par phenol + N₂.
Diazonium ion + phenol (alkali) ya aromatic amine (halka acid): azo dyes; –N=N– chromophore hai.
